name: Eish Al Zawjia
overview: The events revolve around Hamad and his wife Amal, a domineering woman who controls her husband's life and manages it as she pleases. Despite their long marriage, they have not been blessed with children. Hamad's brother, Mosaed, returns from his studies abroad with his wife, Munira, and their young daughter. Since their house is rented, they live in Hamad's house. This leads to Amal's annoyance, as she refuses to share her house with anyone and makes pranks to make Mosaed leave so that the house becomes hers alone.
